The fork

One trained model, three ways of arriving at a long context. Select a road to trace it.

Train short and extendLightningLM V4

Train at 8K, recalibrate the rotary frequencies with DroPE before annealing, evaluate at 256K. A 32x extension bought without paying to train long.

reach 256K, target inside it
Build nativeDeepSeek-V4

Compress every 16 tokens into one entry, select the top 64 blocks per query, keep a 512-token window uncompressed. Train at a million because a million is now affordable.

reach 1M, target inside it
Hybrid scheduleQwen3.6

Gated linear layers carry continuity with an O(1) state, a quarter of the depth keeps sparse attention for exact retrieval, 256K reached from a 32K trained length.

Assumptions, not measurements. Accelerator peak 494.7 TFLOP/s dense bf16 (H100 SXM), model FLOPs utilisation 40%, 80 GB of memory on one device, weights and cache both bf16, backward pass costed at twice the forward. Change them on the left and every derived figure moves.

Train short and extend. LightningLM V4, trained at 8K, reaching 256K.

All three panels are recomputed from the configuration on the left at a target context of 262,144 tokens.

What it costs to trainTrains at 8,192 tokens of sequence. One forward token costs 15.03 GFLOP: dense blocks 12.88 GFLOP, sequence-dependent terms 2.15 GFLOP, which is 14.3%. Over 2.0T tokens the run is 90.19 ZFLOP, or 5,275 GPU-days. Training this architecture natively at 262,144 costs 489.63 ZFLOP, 5.43x as much. That ratio is the whole argument for extending.
What it costs to serveAt 262,144 tokens it holds 262,144 cache entries per layer across 32 attention layers. One conversation is 34.36 GB, which is 100.00% of the yardstick (grouped-query with 8 groups, bf16, head dimension 128, attention at every layer). Weights take 12.88 GB of the 80 GB device, leaving 67.12 GB for 1 simultaneous conversations. One generated token costs 81.60 GFLOP.
What breaks past the design pointThe position scheme gives out. At rotary base 10,000 the slowest of the 32 bands completes one period in 47,117 tokens. At the trained length 8,192, 7 of 32 bands still span the window. At the target 262,144, 0 of 32 do. A band that has wrapped many times reports only where two tokens sit inside one period. One band spanning the target needs a base of at least 58,804, which is what DroPE, NTK scaling and YaRN supply. The target sits inside the demonstrated 32x extension.
At a target of 262,144 tokens, hybrid schedule is the cheapest to train at 4,572 GPU-days, and hybrid schedule is the cheapest to serve at 1.12 GB per conversation. They are usually different roads. Extending is cheap in training and carries a ceiling set by its extension factor. Building native lifts that ceiling and pays up front. The hybrid schedule buys most of the cache saving and inherits an unablated depth ratio. Long context is three decisions.
